note: Chosen over the whole condition grid at once, not per condition: a policy cannot know which error regime it is facing.

plateau_check.note: The grid optimum sat at its upper edge, so larger margins were checked explicitly: 90 -> 0.2840, 105 -> 0.2849, 120 -> 0.2824, 150 -> 0.2848. Spread across the plateau is 0.002, i.e. noise. The smallest margin on the plateau is chosen, by parsimony.

interpretation: Mean J falls monotonically from 0.4249 at a zero margin to a plateau of ~0.284 at and beyond the 90-minute forecast horizon. In this OSSE the value of a forecast comes from using it as a full-horizon early-warning test -- 'order as soon as anything predicted within the window would block the mission' -- and NOT from shaving the decision to the last feasible moment, which is the most error-sensitive point available.
